item.title: In Niger, miners, herders edge out smallholder women from their farms
item.description: By Justina ASISHANA THE battle for land in Niger State is no longer just between man and nature. It is now between farmers, herders, and miners, with women caught in the middle. item.title: Grieving Lagos father blames child’s death on Makoko demolition
item.description: A CARPENTER and father in the Makoko area of Lagos State, Papa Eve Amossou, has alleged that his three-week-old daughter died during the ongoing demolition of the waterfront community by the state government.
